paragraphs.text: Wrestler is an acorn class for those who fight in a way that involves grappling with their opponent in an attempt to force or toss them to the ground.

Wrestler debuted as a creature type in Unstable on the Slaying Mantis which is a humanoid mantis wearing a Lucha libre style mask and boots. On Ixalan , within the Core of Paradise there are gnomes who wrestle known as Cogwork Wrestlers . One defeated a Brazen Coalition orc named Brog in a sparing match despite being half his size and having spent years on the high sea.
Slaying Mantis in Unstable is the only card with this type so far. Non-acorn cards named as wrestlers are rather typed as Performers .
